carotid-eca.title: External carotid spectral waveform
carotid-eca.label: ECA · Spectral Doppler
carotid-eca.note: Compare the higher-resistance ECA waveform in the source S portion. The W beats include temporal tapping and have additional spikes. Exact segment and side are unreported. A separate case used for qualitative comparison on both modeled sides. Cropped to the panel below the original banner, converted losslessly at native scale and orientation.

carotid-vertebral.title: Right vertebral artery spectral waveform
carotid-vertebral.label: Right vertebral artery · Spectral Doppler
carotid-vertebral.note: Compare sustained forward diastolic flow and the opposite color directions in adjacent artery and vein. Exact cervical level is unreported. A separate case used for qualitative comparison on both modeled sides. Cropped to the panel below the original banner, converted losslessly at native scale and orientation.

carotid-subclavian.title: Normal triphasic subclavian spectral waveform
carotid-subclavian.label: Subclavian artery · Triphasic waveform
carotid-subclavian.credit: Lily Bishop and Matthew Bartlett, JRSM Cardiovascular Disease (2021), Figure 2, panel 1
carotid-subclavian.note: Pulsed Doppler waveform from a healthy-volunteer study of the mid-to-distal subclavian artery in a longitudinal infraclavicular view. Panel 1 shows the published normal triphasic pattern. Side and specific arm position are unreported for this panel. The selected panel has no calibrated velocity scale or anatomical inset. It compares waveform shape with the simulated supraclavicular station. Single panel cropped and converted losslessly at native scale and orientation. Noncommercial reuse.

carotid-cca-spectral.title: Right distal common carotid artery pulsed Doppler
carotid-cca-spectral.label: Right distal CCA · Spectral Doppler
carotid-cca-spectral.credit: Arbin Thapaliya, Alec Sithole, Michael Welsh and Gaston Dana, Ultrasound Physics and its Application in Medicine, Figure 10-36
carotid-cca-spectral.note: Acquired distal right common carotid artery in the sagittal plane. The scanner records a brief systolic peak and sustained diastolic flow, with its original angle line, color legend, axis inversion and velocity measurements. This independent case illustrates waveform shape on both sides. It is an exact-level comparison for the distal station and a regional comparison for the proximal station. Lossless WebP conversion without crop, resize or flip.
